fields.Name: T258 - Duplicate Comparison Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the record-comparison slide-in (OpenComparison) with its differences-only filter and survivor/cherry-pick UI — a distinct branch from the detection-run and kanban-board code.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub 'Duplicates' screen (via the application switcher, then Duplicates), if a duplicate group card is present in the kanban board, click it to open the comparison slide-in panel. Success is that the comparison panel opens showing a side-by-side field grid of the source record vs its potential-duplicate matches, with a survivor selector and an 'All Fields' / 'Differences Only' toggle — and that toggling between All Fields and Differences Only changes the set of field rows shown. You do NOT need to perform a merge. If there are no groups to open, running detection first or observing the empty board is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a duplicate group card opens a comparison panel with a side-by-side field grid and a survivor selector
Toggling 'All Fields' vs 'Differences Only' changes the visible field rows
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages (a valid no-groups empty state is acceptable if none exist)
